# Pinned downloads for the tessocr C stack (plans/local-ocr.md; spikes 2026-09-06).
# Format, one record per line, machine-read by build-cstack.sh:
#   <sha256>  <file>  <url>
# Notes live on comment lines, never inline — the fields are a record, not prose.
#
# The tesseract and leptonica versions here are mirrored as pin constants in
# internal/tessocr/tessocr.go (the Identity() the reading record carries);
# build-cstack.sh and TestIdentityMatchesPins each refuse a drift between the two.

# Toolchain (linux-x86_64 HOST binaries; the cross targets all build from this one host).
